title: TypeScript SDK: union recovery hints, shape mappers, and Zod/JSON-schema roundtrip tooling
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Ship a set of TypeScript SDK helpers and typegen adjustments to improve developer ergonomics when consuming structured output from streaming LLM responses. Deliverables include: (1) a lightweight runtime 'shape mapper' that resolves discriminated unions incrementally during stream parsing; (2) optional recovery hint metadata emitted in the SDK for ambiguous union resolution so callers can apply fallback strategies; (3) utilities to roundtrip Zod schemas <-> JSON Schema to drive validation and runtime guards; (4) examples and migration notes for existing tsdk consumers. Goal is fewer runtime exceptions, better errors for end devs, and measurable reduction in post-processing code in apps using structured output and streaming endpoints.
acceptance_criteria:
- Shape mapper exposes a clear contract for incremental stream parsing and returns a typed union result for both streaming and non-streaming flows.
- SDK emits an optional 'recoveryHints' array when union resolution is uncertain (e.g., missing discriminator or ambiguous tag), with docs on suggested developer actions.
- Zod <-> JSON Schema roundtrip tooling provided as stable helpers with unit tests covering common schema patterns (optional properties, nested discriminators, arrays).
- Types generated by tsdk tooling compile without errors for sample repo (example-app) and the runtime validators catch at least 95% of intentionally malformed responses in CI fuzz tests.
- PR with implementation, tests, examples, and README merged and a release note drafted for ts-sdk-2026.04.
design_decisions: Prefer lightweight runtime checks (Zod schemas) over heavy codegen at runtime to avoid large bundle impact for web clients.
Emit structured 'recoveryHints' instead of throwing to allow application-level policies (retry with different prompt, fallback parser, surface to user).
Support both Zod-first and JSON Schema-first workflows: transformations will be deterministic but lossy cases documented (e.g., custom refinements can't roundtrip).
Keep default SDK behavior backward-compatible: existing parsing paths unchanged unless developer opts-in to shape-mapper validation.
implementation_notes: Performance: do prefix parsing of first N bytes for discriminator heuristics to avoid validating huge objects repeatedly. Cache compiled Zod validators per schema fingerprint.
Bundle: ship validation helpers as an optional package import '@redwood/tsdk-validators' to keep core client small.
testing_plan:
- Unit tests for shape mapper: deterministic cases, ambiguous discriminator, missing discriminator, contradictory tag values.
- Integration test: example-app uses streaming chat endpoint with a unioned output (Text | Card | ErrorCard) and exercises recoveryHints to implement UI fallback.
- Fuzz tests in CI: generate malformed payloads and assert validators flag or provide recoveryHints.
- Performance bench: measure parsing latency and memory for 1k concurrent small streams vs baseline; no more than 10% regression.
- Manual QA: pair with Solutions Eng to validate on two customer prompts that previously triggered post-processing exceptions.
updates: 2026-02-10 - Ticket created by Aisha. Context: recurring customer bug where streaming structured outputs occasionally fail because discriminator omitted in streaming chunk boundary.
2026-02-18 - Engineering sync: agreed to emit non-throwing 'recoveryHints' and prototype generator API. Assigned to Miguel. Estimate 8 points.

2026-02-24 - Spike complete: prototype shape mapper that buffers up to 4KB, attempts discriminator heuristics, and hands off to compiled Zod validator. Microbench shows ~6% CPU increase on node but reduced error rate. Saved prototype in drive: https://drive.company.local/tsdk/shape-mapper-spike

2026-03-02 - Design review: PM requested clearer developer ergonomics: add example UI pattern (fallback card) and a migration guide. UX notes added to docs draft. Confluence PR: https://confluence.company.local/display/TS/Union+Recovery+Playbook

2026-03-07 - Internal review: security asked about schema roundtrip leak possibilities; decided to add opt-in flag when using remote schema ingestion. Security note: https://docs.company.local/security/tsdk-schema-ingest

2026-03-10 - Implementation PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ts-sdk/pull/1298 - includes shape mapper, recoveryHints, zod-jsonschema helpers, unit tests. CI failing on one fuzz case; debugging in progress.
